name_en: Compound heat-drought with power and network interruption
name_zh: 高温干旱复合冲击（伴电力/网络中断）
claim: THE DIAGNOSTIC SHOCK OF THIS STUDY. Extreme heat raises irrigation demand at the same moment that hydropower shortfall and grid stress cut the electricity that pumps, sensors, base stations and platforms depend on. Technology efficacy is therefore NOT exogenous: it collapses exactly when it is most needed. The August 2022 Sichuan heat-drought episode with industrial power rationing is the reference event. Any model that applies a fixed percentage loss reduction to smart technology will overstate resilience precisely here, so this shock is the sharpest test of the whole modelling claim and the strongest argument for redundancy and maintenance policies over pure equipment subsidies.

name_zh: 投入品价格冲击（化肥、柴油、电力）
claim: Moved out of the modelled set in the August 2026 scope revision. It was the only shock acting through the CASH constraint rather than the yield function, so no yield-side technology could address its damage and it shared no loss channel with D1-D3. Calibrating it also required a separate price-series data chain (fertiliser, diesel and agricultural electricity indices plus farm-gate output prices) that is not needed for any other part of the model. Retained here because it remains the sharpest test of whether capital subsidies help when the binding constraint is working capital, and because the economic-shock machinery is still present in shocks.py: it can be reinstated by moving this entry back to tier1, with no code change.

name_en: Digital early warning and agro-situation information
name_zh: 数字预警与农情信息服务
claim: Buys lead time. Converts an unanticipated shock into an anticipated one, enabling pre-emptive drainage, irrigation, early harvest or input adjustment. Value is entirely conditional on the farmer having the CAPACITY to act (labour, machinery access) within the action window, which is why T1 and T3 are complements rather than substitutes.

name_en: Digital early warning and agro-situation information

Rural 5G and broadband coverage is effectively universal at village level, so the binding constraint is not connectivity but whether a warning is ACTED ON.

name_en: Smart irrigation, fertigation and field sensing
name_zh: 智慧灌溉、水肥一体化与传感器
claim: Acts directly on the D1 loss mechanism by maintaining root-zone moisture during the reproductive stage. Highest capital intensity of the three, therefore the most exposed to liquidity constraints and the most dependent on maintenance. Requires an existing water source: on hill plots without one, the marginal value is near zero, which is the main source of spatial heterogeneity in returns.

name_en: Smart irrigation, fertigation and field sensing
claim: Provincial targets move smart water-fertiliser integration from about 540 thousand mu across 13 counties towards roughly 1.65 million mu across 40 counties. Effective irrigated area is around 3.0 million ha, so smart fertigation remains a small share of irrigated land and its value is strongly conditional on the underlying irrigation asset.

name_en: Drone and BeiDou smart machinery operating services
name_zh: 无人机植保与北斗智能农机社会化服务
claim: Compresses the time needed to complete a critical operation, which is what converts an early warning into avoided loss. This is the ONLY bundle whose effectiveness is capacity-rationed at the system level: when many farmers are hit simultaneously, the queue lengthens, service arrives after the action window closes and realised efficacy falls even though every farmer is nominally an adopter. That congestion feedback is the primary reason the SD layer exists.

name_en: Drone and BeiDou smart machinery operating services
claim: Provincial targets include more than 200 regional agricultural machinery service centres, upgrading roughly 26 thousand existing terminals, an intelligent assistance and monitoring equipment rate of about 60 per cent, over 15 thousand drones and more than 5 thousand licensed pilots. Comprehensive mechanisation of major crops was around 65 per cent in 2021, below the national level, with maize about 43 per cent and potato about 26 per cent, so machinery capacity is itself scarce and queueing is real rather than notional.

name_en: Precision agricultural insurance with remote sensing loss assessment
name_zh: 精准农业保险与遥感核损
claim: Provincial targets extend precision agricultural insurance towards 176 agricultural counties. Modelled as policy instrument P6 rather than as a technology bundle, because from the farmer's perspective it changes the payoff distribution rather than the production technology. It is also the clearest real-world case of technology making an outcome VERIFIABLE, which is the enabling condition for the outcome-contingent contract in the theoretical model.

name_zh: 设备购置补贴
claim: Lowers K (acquisition cost) in the adoption value function, and the disbursement lag interacts with the liquidity constraint: a farmer who must pay up front and wait 120 days for reimbursement faces a real cost far above the nominal net price. This is why lag is a decision variable and not a fixed constant.
biases towards larger operators with the cash to pre-finance
can produce idle or duplicated equipment
does nothing about maintenance, which is where failure actually bites

name_zh: 按亩服务券
claim: Reduces the per-mu price of purchased services, shifting the adoption choice from ownership towards the service mode. Because it raises DEMAND without raising CAPACITY, on its own it lengthens queues, and under a correlated shock it can lower realised efficacy for everyone. The interaction between P2 and P3 is the single most policy-relevant non-linearity in the model.
congestion and delayed operations at peak
remote farmers still served last despite holding vouchers

claim: Raises digital literacy, which lowers the learning cost term and raises the probability of reaching the effectively-used state. Skill decays without follow-up, so one-off training campaigns produce a transient bump that the model will show fading.

name_zh: 预警＋应急作业保障
claim: Combines information with reserved operating capacity, so that a warning can actually be acted on during a correlated shock. Designed specifically to break the D2 and D3 failure mode where everyone is warned simultaneously and nobody can get served.

name_en: Precision insurance with remote sensing loss assessment
name_zh: 精准农业保险与遥感核损
claim: Changes the outcome distribution the farmer faces rather than the production function, so it acts directly on the risk-aversion channel: it lowers the effective c1 and therefore, through Proposition 1, shifts the equilibrium contract form and the effort the provider supplies. Payout speed governs post-shock replanting and recovery time.
